description: This Java class defines properties for configuring an HTTP protocol adapter in the Eclipse Hono project. It specifies configurable parameters like the realm used for device authentication, defaulting to 'Hono'. The class extends ProtocolAdapterProperties and provides getter and setter methods for the realm property.

classes.name: HttpProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: A class representing configuration properties for an HTTP protocol adapter, including realm settings for authentication.

methods.name: getRealm
methods.description: Returns the name of the realm that devices are prompted to authenticate against.

methods.name: setRealm
methods.description: Sets the name of the realm, ensuring it is not null.
